Maren Tideward's harbor lantern — the one that keeps the fog (and what walks in it) off Graywater Quay — went dark last night and will not relight. She is offering salvage rights to the wreck of the *Brinemark* to whoever finds out why.

**Objective:** discover why the salt-lantern died, and restore it or replace what it was protecting the quay from.

Related: loc-graywater-quay, npc-maren-tideward
